name: Pho
covers: Main, kids and drinks menus in UK restaurants

order.intro: Pho's guide lists most dishes without their sauces, and the sauces on their own. Tick a dish and the sauce you'd like with it.

Vermicelli noodles.why: Bún dishes come with a spring roll, which contains wheat.

headline: Ask for Bún dishes without the wheat spring roll.
tips: Coeliac UK accredited: Pho says it's audited and tested by Coeliac UK. Its own words are on the Warnings page.
Bún (vermicelli) dishes come with a wheat spring roll: ask for them without it.
Avoid: crispy and seafood spring rolls, hoisin sauce, kids' chicken nuggets and the beers.
Sauces: the guide lists most dishes without sauce, so check the sauce too.
gaps: The guide shows allergens per dish, not per ingredient, so it doesn't say which part of a dish contains gluten.
Daura Damm is a beer made from barley malt with the gluten removed. The guide names barley without its usual mark, so it's on the Avoid list here.
Pho says staff can make mistakes and that all allergens are present in its kitchens.
